claims.scope: RiskEngine.twapEMA() computes a TWAP from OraclePack.getEMAs() return values; that TWAP feeds PanopticPool.getTWAP() liquidation solvency checks, the StaleOracle gate, and premium/exercise pricing

preconditions.text: Short-horizon price movement propagates into spotEMA faster than into the longer-horizon EMAs.; The TWAP returned by PanopticPool.getTWAP() is used in liquidation solvency checks (atTicks[1] = twapTick) and in the StaleOracle gate |currentTick - twapTick| > tickDeltaLiquidation.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The StaleOracle gate and liquidation solvency evaluation should reflect the intended smoothed TWAP so that stale conditions revert and valid conditions proceed.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The altered TWAP changes outcomes of the StaleOracle safety boundary and solvency evaluation, so the system may proceed when it should revert as stale, or revert when it should proceed.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The TWAP value is consumed by the StaleOracle gate and liquidation solvency checks as stated; the concrete tickDeltaLiquidation threshold is not needed for this symbolic plan.
The report describes the outcome flip as possible rather than observed; the plan encodes the forbidden outcome symbolically.

limitations: The intended smoothed TWAP formula (6*fastEMA + 3*slowEMA + eonsEMA)/10 is not encoded as a numeric relation because the selected impact is the gate outcome flip, not the formula mismatch; formula mismatch is a separate impact.
The outcome flip is stated as potential, so the plan formalizes the forbidden outcome symbolically rather than as an observed event.
Liquidation harm and bad-debt accumulation are downstream consequences handled in separate claim-generation passes.
